title: 公共内容1000条、品牌兼容及TikTok/AI整理修复
changes: 新公共内容任务最大1000条，完整解析来源页并轮流分页，移除分组平均额度及20条提前截断；旧冻结任务不自动扩量
自动兼容elahring和Elah Ring写法；TikTok支持aweme包装与嵌套列表，未知非空结构明确保存解析错误
AI使用批内短ID和可信quoteId，逐条校验并保留有效结果，坏行不再丢弃整批；非JSON保留原因及用量
正文429遵循Retry-After与至少60秒同域冷却，复用缓存并继续其他来源和AI；1000条快照及AI按100项读取

validation.development: 90 service tests, 1 isolated PGlite API integration, 9 frontend tests passed; full web typecheck, isolated server-mode build, targeted ESLint/format/diff checks; desktop and 390px synthetic UI, zero page errors.
validation.release: Repeat tests/regression/typecheck/lint/isolated DB/UI, validation builds and CI wait skipped by user policy. Official frontend and API image each generated once.
validation.limitations: No live provider/model acceptance. Historical TikTok raw response not retained. 1000 is a total cap, not a guarantee; Google/Instagram APIs retain documented 11-page limit. Old 5/25 job is not reprocessed.
